page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: large display title in capitals over four lines, then a block of text in roman type, then a block of inverted lines, then short lines of text, a Bible reference, a motto, a printer's device (anchor and emblem), and the imprint at the foot. No running head, page number or signature.

main_text.l: Accedat opera quadruplex index, vt non modo Gnosio-
logiae haereticorum, sed etiam quae scriptis vellitis per-
cipi poterit intelligeretur, & quibus in vsqueque Deo,
ecclesiae praeest, Symbolli Apostolici, item di-
Ecclesiae operis addita sit in hac haeresin, ex qua quaedam alia ex
aliquibus fini & perspicuam ex scripta vnam quaedam quamplu-
Aliquis est praecepta mihi a Deo de Ecclesia, vt quaedam fratum
praedicabilia fuerunt in Papistica tyrannide incoderint, offensa
Quorum haereses vt ex quo ut qui probati sint.

page.notes: Scan is a title page with show-through: the inverted and faint lines in the middle and lower half are hard to read and are marked as illegible where I could not resolve them. The anchor device is not printed text. The Munich library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) at the lower left is not transcribed. Several lines in the middle block are doubtful. The imprint "GENEVAE" and "M. D. LXXVIII." (1578) are read from the scan.
